name: Ethereality Estridge
source:
Ethereality Estridge is absolute perfection and she knows it. Hates it, really, but her winning smile would convince anyone otherwise. Loves femininity despite it being the death of her (god, she is not a girl, but will never admit it to herself); gorges on being the prettiest of pretty by not eating, or at least she tries. Barbie bones and a sucker for drama, in love with her best frenemies, a Christ-alive femme fatale in the making. Wants a basin of Angelwood's holiest water, so she can douse the devil in it.

[From [url=https://rosesrot.itch.io/gluttony-gods]itch.io[/url]]
